adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `blacklistedGuestEmails` are normalized via `.toLowerCase()`, but the incoming `guest` strings are compared without normalization: `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` and attendee de-dupe uses `guest === attendee.email`. Since `guests` come directly from input (`z.string().email()` does not lowercase), mixed-case emails can bypass both the blacklist and the existing-attendee check.
